S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  Short Term Bail Application (IA No. 2518 of 2024)

In  CRLA No. 672 of 2019  Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Pankaj Miglani, Advocate for the appellant/applicant.
2. Mr. J.S. Virk, Deputy Advocate General with Mr. Rakesh Kumar Joshi, Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. Mr. Parikshit Saini, Advocate for the complainant.
4. Appellant has been convicted for offence punishable under Sections 302, 498A and 201 IPC.
Challenging his conviction, he has filed this Appeal.
5. Appellant has sought short term bail on the ground of illness of his mother.
According to him, his mother, who is 70 years old, sustained fracture in her backbone for which she needs to be operated.
6. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the date given for surgery by the Doctor of Government Doon Medical College Hospital, Dehradun, is 21.08.2024.

entities.text: Government Doon Medical College Hospital, Dehradun
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: He further submits that appellant's father is also very ill, who is aged about 82 years and there is no one in the family of appellant to look after his mother.
7. Learned State Counsel was asked to get instructions.
On instructions, he submits that some injury has been caused on the backbone of the appellant's mother.

8. Having regard to the fact that appellant is the only son; his father is old and ailing and his mother needs surgical intervention, therefore, we are inclined to grant short term bail for a period of two weeks to the appellant.
CRLA/672/2019 on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106435824/
1 9. Accordingly, the short term bail application is allowed.

Let the appellant- Manish Arora be enlarged on short term bail only for a period of two weeks from the date of his release, on his executing personal bond with two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Court concerned.

10. Needless to say that immediately after expiry of two weeks, appellant shall surrender before the Superintendent of the Jail concerned.
11.
List this appeal in due course.
